items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had D.D. George Lewis, Clay Badge. stuff with stuff That's when I got a job. I was working at the Kingfish.

ctx.x: What was it before you went in? Oh, it was a restaurant and bar. Used to have seafood, you know, thing like that. And the bar and port. And, uh, where the dance division is now, that was open. That was open between there and the house in the back, which is the home. They lived there and they had empty light in between. They closed the lot and built a dance hall.

Yeah. Mm-hmm. That's the beginning of that. Oh, I see. So you were the first band in there then? No, no. Mealy. Mealy was the first band in there. And they didn't stay there too long, I don't think, before they got me in there, before I was down there. Oh. Well, who was the band leader when you went to Lutches? Who was the band leader? I was the band leader. Mm-hmm. And who'd you have with you then? I had D.D. George Lewis, Clay Badge. stuff with stuff That's when I got a job. I was working at the Kingfish.
